summary: Prioritize tangible, everyday curiosity topics over abstract scientific phenomena.
Use English or Hinglish phrasing with visual emojis in titles to immediately capture attention on the feed.
Ensure hook sentences start with a dramatic, high-stakes question or statement rather than a dry explanatory premise.
Keep video lengths structured around the 40-45 second mark to optimize retention pacing.
Eliminate low-energy, purely academic hook openings that cause immediate swipe-away rates above 70%.
winning_hooks: Space missions mein astronauts ke liye sirf ek thin plastic sheet jaan bacha sakti hai 🤯
250 km/h ki speed se गीली runway पर plane hydroplaning से कैसे बचता है?
राजमा रात भर फ्रिज में रखने के बाद अक्सर अलग स्वाद क्यों देता है?
avoid: Ever thought why deep ocean snow helps cycle carbon?
डायनासोर के जीवाश्मों में वैज्ञानिकों को ऐसी सूक्ष्म आकृतियां क्यों मिली हैं जो खून की कोशिकाओं जैसी दिखती हैं?
next_experiment: Test an English-only versus a Hinglish hook on the exact same everyday science topic to determine which drives a higher stayed_pct above the 50% threshold.
